question: Can previously blank neural concept slots be selected, addressed and populated entirely through numeric threshold activity and generic local synaptic writes on observed consequences, without Python determining chosen slot, context identity or outcome lookup?
frozen_worlds: 256 exhaustive 3-bit Boolean functions plus 72 four-bit Boolean functions (eight named masks, 64 SHA256 deterministic distinct masks), 328 total worlds. 3200 observed context/label events, deterministic seeded permutation, no labels prefilled.
primary: Before 3200 first observations, abstain; after each genuine observation correctly recall label; after complete exposure 3200/3200 correct recalled labels. Full scope 4 binary inputs, fixed 16 blank schema slots and 97 plastic coefficients.
comparators: Independent exact symbolic map same public data (expected perfect parity) and fully trained 16-parameter one-hot logistic Adam gradient baseline on eight fixed four-bit truth tables (128 outputs, BCE<=0.02 by 3000 epochs or unqualified). Identical observed labels; no total compute/architecture claim.
falsification: 328 duplicate-label contradictions must set numeric fault and suppress all outputs; no inference on never-observed input. All inputs with five bits rejected. Zero used memory destroys recall, zero address bits degrades some recall, zero positive reward bit invalidates that prediction; 328 exact cold restores/four-event replays.
information_bound: For arbitrary 4-bit truth tables, 16 independent unknown labels require up to 16 observations for guaranteed full correctness. Direct programming does not avoid this lower bound.
novelty_limit: Synthesizes concept *instances* with observed addresses in blank slots and neural-generated allocation. The comparison is not an unknown operator generator; equality/memory/first-free prior remains fixed.
engineering: Exact source GitHub-hosted Windows + Linux original plus WSP01-09 regression, 328-world runner, stable source atlas, full tree clean, same SHA.
scientific: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY; independently unfamiliar unknown task distribution, superiority over strong controls, matched energy/compute, and open-ended novel-operator invention all UNVERIFIED. Preserve all negatives.
authority: Draft isolated Yggdrasil research branch. No new controller, schedule, runner dispatch, runtime, merge, accepted main, training loop, paid API, independent first-use, deployment.
